info.title: Thrift Nest Demo API
info.description: Fictional catalogue and persistent pending orders. No payments or reservations.

get.description: Use for size, measurements, NGN price and availability. Missing measurements are unknown. price_minor is integer kobo.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Fictional catalogue code such as TN-DEMO-001.

200.description: Successful operation; inspect success, found and order fields.

400.description: Invalid input or missing customer confirmation.

409.description: Item unavailable or quoted price changed; do not claim success.

get.summary: Retrieve or reconcile a pending order
get.description: Use before retrying uncertain writes or for repeated requests. Only found=false in a successful result proves absence.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Fictional item code such as TN-DEMO-001.

200.description: Successful operation; inspect success, found and order fields.

400.description: Invalid input or missing customer confirmation.

409.description: Item unavailable or quoted price changed; do not claim success.

post.summary: Record one confirmed unpaid pending request
post.description: Call only after explicit customer confirmation. Pass the lookup price_minor as expected_price_minor and customer_confirmed=true. Does not reserve stock or prove payment. Repeated customer/item requests return the same order. PRICE_CHANGED requires lookup and renewed customer confirmation; uncertain results require get_pending_order.

customer_ref.description: Fictional demo customer reference. Reuse exactly for retries.

expected_price_minor.description: price_minor returned by lookup_product, in kobo. Do not pass the displayed naira amount.

customer_confirmed.description: Set true only after the customer explicitly confirms the quoted unpaid pending request. The backend rejects false.

200.description: Successful operation; inspect success, found and order fields.

400.description: Invalid input or missing customer confirmation.

409.description: Item unavailable or quoted price changed; do not claim success.

201.description: New pending order saved; actual order ID returned.
